The site has five areas, one per navbar item, and each area has one sidebar.
A page belongs to exactly one area: the folder it lives in under `docs/`. The
Chinese pages have the same paths under `zh-TW/docs/`; the SGB design pages
exist in Chinese only.

## Areas of the site {#areas}

| Area | What it holds | Folder |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Get started | The home page (`README.md`, shown by `index.qmd`), installing, the first simulation and choosing a simulation | `docs/start/` |
| Guides | One task per page: preparing and checking a layout, computing a quantity with one solver, reading results, running elsewhere, working with a finished run, the flip-chip Xmon worked example and upgrading | `docs/guides/` |
| Concepts | The physical problem and the model behind each calculation | `docs/concepts/` |
| Reference | What is supported, terms and units, the API index and the detailed specifications | `docs/reference/` |
| Contribute | This map, the code map, architecture, ownership, provenance, the notebook contract, research and history; in Chinese also the SGB design | `docs/contribute/` |

A page that moves keeps its old URL as a Quarto `aliases:` entry, so links from
earlier releases still arrive; links between pages always use the current
path. The PDK notebook for each calculation is listed on
[Choose a simulation](../start/choose-a-simulation.qmd).
